name: io.github.Scormave/gramps-web-mcp
title: Gramps Web MCP
description: MCP server for structured access to Gramps Web genealogy data

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Pinned to stdio for registry-installed containers that the client spawns itself. The image's own default is http (Streamable HTTP on port 8080) for networked Docker deployments; see the README for that setup.

environmentVariables.name: GRAMPS_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your Gramps Web instance

environmentVariables.name: GRAMPS_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Gramps Web API password or token

environmentVariables.name: GRAMPS_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to block create, update, and delete tools

environmentVariables.name: GRAMPS_MUTATION_SERIALIZE
environmentVariables.description: Serialize create/update/delete HTTP calls in-process (set false to allow parallel writes)

environmentVariables.name: GRAMPS_MUTATION_MIN_INTERVAL_MS
environmentVariables.description: Minimum milliseconds between mutation HTTP calls. Use 250 or 500 on SQLite if you see database is locked
